grammar.title: Partitive Articles (di + article)
grammar.explanation: In Italian, when talking about 'some' or an unspecified quantity of food, you use the partitive article formed by 'di' + the definite article: del (di + il), della (di + la), dell' (di + l'), dello (di + lo), dei (di + i), delle (di + le), degli (di + gli). For example: 'Compro del pane' (I buy some bread), 'Vorrei dell'acqua' (I would like some water). This is commonly used with food and drink items.
